title: Orchestration configuration
prompt: Configure the current multiagent type and explicitly choose whether subagents, workflows, and an advisor are enabled.

examples.code:
multiagent:
  type: multiagent_20261001
  subagents:
    type: enabled
    inline_agents: { type: enabled }
  workflows:
    type: disabled
  advisor:
    type: enabled
    model: claude-opus-5-5
examples.label: YAML reference excerpt

takeaway: Configure the current multiagent type and explicitly choose whether subagents, workflows, and an advisor are enabled.
